module.name: UTF8Process
module.short: Implements a version of the FCL TProcess component that allows UTF-8-encoded arguments.

descr.p: utf8process.pp implements the TProcessUTF8 component which provides a TProcess descendant that allows UTF-8-encoded values in its properties. The TProcessUTF8 component is added to the System tab in the Lazarus IDE Component Palette.
utf8process.pp is part of the LazUtils package.

element.name: TProcessUTF8
element.short: Implements a version of the FCL TProcess class that allows UTF-8-encoded arguments.

descr.p: TProcessUTF8 is a TProcess descendant which implements a version of TProcess that accepts and processes UTF-8-encoded arguments. It includes a ParseCmdLine method used to separate a command line into the Executable name and Parameters used in the class instance. Other properties and methods are inherited from the FCL TProcess ancestor. For example:
See TProcess for more information.
TProcessUTF8 is used in the implementation of the Lazarus IDE and related tools like the Debugger, HTML Help viewer, external tools, and the FPDoc Editor.
Use TAsyncProcess for a process which receives asynchronous notifications during process execution.

element.name: TProcessUTF8.ParseCmdLine
element.short: Separates values in the CommandLine argument into the Executable and Parameters properties.

descr.p: ParseCmdLine is used to separate the values in the CmdLine argument into the values used for the Executable and Parameters properties.
ReadBackSlash indicates if the BackSlash character (\) is used to quote a character value in the command line. The default value for the argument is False.

ParseCmdLine creates an internal TStringList instance used to store values returned from the SplitCmdLineParams routine in lazfileutils.pas. The first value in the string list (when present) is stored in the Executable property. The remaining values are stored in the Parameters property.
ParseCmdLine is provided as a convenience method. The same result can be achieved by setting the values in the Executable and Parameters properties directly.

element.name: TProcessUTF8.ParseCmdLine.CmdLine
element.short: Command line examined and parsed in the method.

element.name: TProcessUTF8.ParseCmdLine.ReadBackslash
element.short: When True, the BackSlash character is used to quote character values.

element.name: RunCmdFromPath
element.short: Executes a command using the specified parameters and process options.

descr.p: RunCmdFromPath is used to execute a command which can be found in the current PATH environment. For example, the following locates and executes the /bin/ls -l /home command:
An exception is raised if the program file cannot be located, or cannot be executed.
RunCmdFromPath creates and configures a TProcessUTF8 instance which is used to execute the program file.

ProgramFilename contains the qualified executable file name for the process. If the argument contains a Space (' '), it is surrounded by Quotation Mark (") characters before it is assigned to the class instance.

CmdLineParameters contains optional parameters values for the executable file. It is assumed that parameter values with embedded spaces are already quoted when passed to the routine. CmdLineParameters is included in the class instance when the value is not an empty string ('').

ProcessOpts contains the set of TProcessOption values enabled during execution of the process. The default value for the parameter is [poWaitOnExit], and causes Execute to wait for completion of the process before setting the exit status and exit code.

RunCmdFromPath calls the Execute method in the TProcessUTF8 instance to execute the specified program file name with the specified parameter values and process options. The process instance is configured so that it does not inherit handles for StdIn, StdOut, and StdErr during process execution.

dl.dd: Raised with the message in lrsProgramFileNotFound or lrsCanNotExecute.

element.version: Modified in LazUtils version 2.3.0 to wait for process exit during execution. Modified in LazUtils version 5.0 to accept process options as a parameter.

element.name: RunCmdFromPath.CmdLineParameters
element.short: Command line parameters for the program.

element.name: RunCmdFromPath.ProcessOpts
element.short: Set of process options enabled during execution of the command.

element.name: FindFilenameOfCmd
element.short: Gets the full path for the specified executable file.

descr.p: FindFilenameOfCmd is a String function used to get the full path for the executable file specified in the ProgramFilename argument. FindFilenameOfCmd calls the FilenameIsAbsolute routine to determine if a relative path in ProgramFilename needs to be resolved. FindDefaultExecutablePath is called to search the PATH environment when path information is not used in ProgramFilename.
The return value contains the absolute path and file name. If the file does not exist on the local file system, the return value is an empty string ('').

element.name: FindFilenameOfCmd.Result
element.short: Absolute path to the requested program file, or an empty string.

element.name: FindFilenameOfCmd.ProgramFilename
element.short: Program file examined in the method.

element.name: GetSystemThreadCount
element.short: Gets the number of threads available on the system.

descr.p: GetSystemThreadCount is an Integer function used to get the number of threads on the system. The implementation for GetSystemThreadCount is platform- and/or OS-specific. For the Windows environment, the total number of processors available (including logical hyperthreaded processors) are returned using the GetProcessAffinityMask API. When GetProcessAffinityMask is unavailable, the total number of processors from GetSystemInfo is used. For UNIX-like environments, either the sysconf or the fpsysctl function is used. For other environments, the return value is always 1.

element.name: GetSystemThreadCount.Result
element.short: The number of threads on the system.

element.name: Register
element.short: Registers components for use in the Lazarus IDE.

descr.p: Register is a procedure used to make components in the unit available for use in the Lazarus IDE. Register calls RegisterComponents to make the TProcessUTF8 available on the System tab.
